title: Limits of Statistical Assurance for Embodied and Agentic AI under Adaptive Adversaries
abstract: arXiv:2610.18948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Finite safety assessments cannot exclude an adversary that preserves unattacked behavior until certification and activates afterward. We characterize this limitation for embodied and tool-use AI. An adversary that matches the complete observation law until observable, irrevocable certification and retains intervention access afterward attains $v\mathbb{E}[(n-S_0)_+]$ expected post-certification events over $n$ trials, where $v$ is the active event probability and $S_0$ the unattacked certification time. The result covers adaptive and privately randomized evaluators. Switching at certification is exactly optimal for a fixed likelihood-ratio test under memoryless, event-increasing interventions without a binding intervention budget. translated_title: 自适应对手下具身智能与智能体AI统计保障的极限
translated_abstract: 有限的安全评估无法排除那些在认证之前保持未受攻击行为、之后才激活的对手。我们针对具身智能和工具使用型AI刻画了这一局限性。一个在可观测、不可撤销的认证之前完全匹配观测规律、并在之后保留干预能力的对手，在 $n$ 次试验中可达到 $v\mathbb{E}[(n-S_0)_+]$ 的预期认证后事件数，其中 $v$ 是激活事件概率，$S_0$ 是未受攻击的认证时间。该结果覆盖了自适应评估器和私有随机化评估器。在无记忆、事件递增干预且不存在约束性干预预算的情况下，在认证时刻切换对于固定似然比检验而言是精确最优的。当干预在授权部署时间范围内提高事件率时，即使认证被推迟到最后期限，正向的清洁认证要求也会导致线性增长的最坏情况预期超额。
tldr: 本文证明了对于具身智能和智能体AI，任何有限时长的安全认证在原理上都无法排除那些在认证前伪装正常行为、认证后才激活的隐蔽自适应对手，并精确刻画了此类攻击带来的最坏情形期望损失。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that finite-duration safety certification fundamentally cannot exclude stealthy adaptive adversaries that mimic normal behavior until certification and activate afterward, precisely characterizing the worst-case expected post-certification loss for embodied and agentic AI.
